propositions: summary_compute resolves ticket state but omits the resolved alias field from its return payload, causing agents to default to locally salient four-character prefixes
the summary JSON schema and library/MCP/CLI contracts lack the resolved alias in their shape definitions, institutionalizing an alias-free interface
agents must affirmatively select aliases for tracker commands after discovery and reserve canonical UUIDs for identity-sensitive artifacts, but current guidance does not enforce this distinction

pinned behavioral evaluation demonstrates that adding the resolved alias field to local summaries independently produces 25/25 alias-based commands versus 25/25 prefix-based commands without the field
ticket_id echo contract and ambiguous-prefix fail-closed behavior must be preserved while adding the exact resolved alias as an additive field
